interpretation.plain_speak: As dependencies close and new writes arrive, Wingless can recompute the remaining write budget exactly from the live recall state. Across 72 controlled snapshots it never missed the countdown.
interpretation.north_star_question: Strengthens the native warning from a static pre-loss countdown into a dynamically updating time-to-failure estimate under changing dependency pressure.
interpretation.next_stage: evaluate the countdown online at every event and test whether it remains exact across alternating STORE and REPORT transitions, then quantify earliest actionable warning horizon without intervention
